text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While in the cafeteria, I overhear Sakura
Chiyono
O explaining herself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...So that's why this time, I'm going over
to
Maruzen's place!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That sounds great! Maruzen lives on her
own,
right?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Which brings us to your dilemma—what
kind of
gift you should take with you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. It's just as they say, "Manners
between
friends is like turf between
toes."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...There's a saying like that?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In any case, Maruzen is very mature, so
perhaps
you could give her something
sophisticated.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but she does have that
mischievous side,
too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A while back, when she was
recommending some
of her favorite
music, she handed me a cassette
tape,
but I have no way of playing it...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Her favorite music?! I hope she plays me
some
music she likes when I visit her!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Personally, I've always thought of
Maruzen as
being a really cool and
impressive runner!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I hope that someday I'll not only
reach
her level, but surpass it as well.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen loves fast things, so maybe we
should
think of something along those
lines?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A present that gives a sense of speed...
Hmm, I
can't think of anything.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maybe something homemade would be
better? I
often make Japanese-style
treats.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Then what about some dynamically shaped red bean jelly?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I'm having trouble picturing a
"dynamic"
jelly shape...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, what if we shape it like a sports car?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Nice idea! I could make some car-shaped
nerikiri
sweets!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's decided. I'll give her some
homemade
Japanese sweets.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... but Maruzen often talks about
desserts with
foreign names, doesn't
she?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, things like tiramisu and nata de
coco.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she doesn't actually like
Japanese stuff all
that much.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aww... And it was such a good idea, too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I happen to make eye contact with
Sakura
Chiyono O as she brainstorms
with her
companions.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um! Excuse me! Do you know what
kind of
gifts adults like? Would you be
happy if someone
gave you Japanese
sweets?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A thoughtful gift... Understood! I'll stake

everything on what I'm most confident
in—my
Japanese sweets!
choice_data_list: 気持ちがこもっていれば、なんでも！
相手の趣味に合わせるといいかも
choice_data_list_en: As long as your heart's in it, anything works!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You're peerless in how you make
Japanese sweets
and how you aspire to
be like Maruzen. I'm
certain she'll love
your gift.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Oh, would you mind taste
testing
them sometime? It'd be a big
help.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But of course. I absolutely can't wait.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'll help too! Let me know whenever you
need a
taste tester!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm so grateful! I'll do my best to make
something
the two of you will enjoy too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see! Then maybe I should try my hand
at some
western-style treats!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that anything you make will
taste truly
delicious, Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... Um, the things Maruzen
mentions
most are tiramisu, nata de
coco, and...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: She likes italian food, too, right?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Pasta and such aren't really desserts
though...
